label: Dam / water authority
description: A dam, reservoir and powerhouse (hydro and/or flood control) operated by a regional water authority: spillway gates, intakes, penstocks and units, SCADA, dam safety, downstream communities. Plans: the Emergency Action Plan (FEMA P-64 emergency levels; 18 CFR Part 12 for FERC-licensed projects) with its notification flowchart and inundation maps.

vocabulary.public: downstream residents, recreational visitors and boaters
vocabulary.frontline: dam tenders, control room operators, patrol staff, maintenance crews, gate attendants
vocabulary.operationsCenter: the dam control room and the authority's operations center

factCategories.label: Spillway gates
factCategories.noun: Spillway Gates?|Radial Gates?|Tainter Gates?|Crest Gates?|Sluice Gates?

it: dam safety instrumentation database and ADAS server
ot: PACS and CCTV at the dam
reservoir level and tailwater gauges, seismic accelerometers
telemetry links (licensed radio, GOES satellite, cellular)
backup diesel generators for the gates
waterside barrier booms and UAS detection

roles.name: Dam Operations Manager (Incident Commander)
roles.description: Owns the dam, the gates, the units and the operators.

roles.name: SCADA / IT Security Lead (Technical Lead)
roles.description: Owns the control system, the network and the investigation.

roles.name: Public Affairs Officer
roles.description: Owns public warnings, social media and the press.

roles.name: Security Manager
roles.description: Owns the perimeter, access control, patrols and the law-enforcement liaison.

roles.name: Dam Safety Engineer
roles.description: Owns the structural assessment, the EAP condition levels and regulator reporting.

roles.name: EAP Coordinator
roles.description: Owns the notification flowchart, the inundation maps and the annual EAP drill.

roles.name: Reservoir / Water Control Manager
roles.description: Owns release schedules, flood routing and coordination with the River Forecast Center and other dams.

outsideParties: National Weather Service (flash flood and dam-failure warnings)
county emergency management and the sheriff
the regional grid operator / balancing authority
the FERC Regional Engineer (safety-related incidents reported as soon as practicable, preferably within 72 hours)
the NWS River Forecast Center and USGS stream gauges
hospitals and schools in the inundation zone
mediaChannels: downstream residents on Facebook and Nextdoor
a boater's post on X/Twitter with a photo

sceneAnchors.public: at a public overlook below a concrete gravity dam: visitors at a railing, the spillway face, mist over the tailrace, the river below, daylight
sceneAnchors.control: inside a hydroelectric plant control room: an older console with analog gauges and dark monitors, an operator in a hard hat and safety vest, fluorescent light
sceneAnchors.exterior: on the crest road of a concrete dam: spillway gate hoists, an intake tower, a white service pickup truck, the reservoir on one side and a steep wooded valley on the other
